reports.standfirst: Coventry City beat Sunderland 3-1, Tatsuhiro Sakamoto's long-range strike setting them on their way.
reports.account:
Sakamoto opened the scoring in the 17th minute, his left-footed shot from beyond the box staying low and finding the corner. It gave Coventry a lead they never gave up at any stage. Taiwo Awoniyi doubled it after 37 minutes, striking right-footed from inside the area and low into the corner, and Sunderland trailed by two at the interval.
Jack Rudoni put Coventry 3-0 up in the 52nd minute, taking Victor Torp's pass and skidding a left-footed shot from distance low into one corner. Enzo Le Fée's penalty pulled one back after 67 minutes, struck right-footed to the top corner. Omar Alderete was booked twice and sent off deep into stoppage time.

sections.head: Rudoni hits three
sections.pitch: Rudoni has three league goals this season after four shots here, and his defending drew the full award a match can carry.
sections.stake: A free agent since The Truffle Pigs let him go on Wednesday; nine points.

sections.head: Awoniyi doubles advantage
sections.pitch: Awoniyi's was the only one of Coventry's three goals struck with the right foot, Sakamoto and Rudoni both scoring with their left.

sections.head: Sakamoto breaks deadlock
sections.pitch: Sakamoto's strike from range was one of two such Coventry goals in the match, Rudoni's after the break being the other.

reports.standfirst: Chelsea beat Manchester United 2-0, adding to their lead moments after Lisandro Martínez was sent off.
reports.account:
Matheus Cunha had the ball in the net after 34 minutes from Harry Maguire's pass, but a video review ruled the goal out. Morgan Rogers put Chelsea ahead early in the second half, finishing Roméo Lavia's pass left-footed into the middle of the goal from inside the box. Martínez was booked again and sent off 13 minutes after Rogers's goal, leaving United to play on with ten men.
Cole Palmer scored from the spot one minute after the red card, low into the bottom corner with his left foot. Estêvão saw a goal of his own struck off by video review with 19 minutes left, Palmer having set him up. Amad Diallo was forced off injured after 77 minutes.

sections.head: Lavia feeds Rogers
sections.pitch: Lavia and Wesley Fofana were each paid the maximum for their defending, Fofana lasting the full match as United were kept out. Marco Palestra featured for Chelsea too.
sections.stake: Lavia, a free agent, eight points; Palestra, a free agent, six points in his first league start this season; Fofana, a free agent, 11 points.

sections.head: Colwill denies United
sections.pitch: Levi Colwill was on the pitch from start to finish without Chelsea conceding, and his defending was paid once, half the maximum on offer.
sections.stake: The Raccoons claimed him on Thursday, for seven points.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Fofana 11, Palmer 10 (The Raccoons), Rogers 8 (If anyone can, Bannan can), Acheampong 8

reports.standfirst: AFC Bournemouth's 2-0 defeat of Leeds United left the visitors five matches without a win.
reports.account: Dominic Calvert-Lewin scored for Leeds after 11 minutes, but video review struck the goal off. Evanilson broke the deadlock after 31 minutes, meeting Justin Kluivert's pass inside the area and finishing right-footed, low in the corner, to put the Cherries ahead. Amine Adli, on for Rayan, scored deep into stoppage time, finishing low beside the post with his right foot from a through ball by Junior Kroupi, who had come on for Kluivert.

sections.head: Evanilson reaches four
sections.pitch: James Hill completed the match without Leeds scoring. Evanilson now has four league goals this season, with a point for his defending besides.
sections.stake: GlengarryHearts has Hill on the bench, for six points; If anyone can, Bannan can has Evanilson, for seven points against GlengarryHearts.

sections.head: Kluivert creates opener
sections.pitch: António Silva saw out the match with nothing conceded, his covering at the back worth a single mark. Kluivert has the assist for the breakthrough to his name.
sections.stake: Cowthenbeef claimed Silva on Wednesday, for seven points; Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has Kluivert, for six points against Cowthenbeef.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Truffert 7 (If anyone can, Bannan can), Silva 7 (Cowthenbeef), Petrovic 7 (The Raccoons), Evanilson 7 (If anyone can, Bannan can)

reports.standfirst: Nottingham Forest stay in the bottom three after a 2-0 defeat at Brentford, Nikola Milenkovic's own goal setting them back.
reports.account: Milenkovic scored an own goal in the 30th minute to give Brentford the lead, and Forest trailed at half-time. Igor Thiago added another with 14 minutes left, finishing on the break with a right-footed shot high into the middle from Jaidon Anthony's pass, Anthony having replaced Dango Ouattara.

sections.head: Igor Thiago, Anthony combine
sections.pitch: Igor Thiago now has two league goals this season and added a mark for his defending. Anthony set up that goal within minutes of his arrival from the bench.
sections.stake: The Truffle Pigs has Igor Thiago, for seven points; domeitalycoach has Anthony, for four points.

sections.head: Ouattara's defending recognised
sections.pitch: Ouattara picked up a single mark for his positional sense, half of what one match can pay, before he made way for the substitute.
sections.stake: The Raccoons claimed him on Friday, for six points.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: van den Berg 7, Igor Thiago 7 (The Truffle Pigs), Ajer 7, Ouattara 6 (The Raccoons)

keyStats.label: Clean sheet, full match
keyStats.value: van den Berg, Kelleher, Ajer, Kayode, Lewis-Potter

reports.standfirst: Hull City drew 2-2 with Ipswich Town, Oliver McBurnie's strike giving them only a brief lead.
reports.account: Florentino gave Ipswich the lead after 22 minutes, running onto Abdoul Ouattara's through ball and squeezing a low right-footed shot into the corner from a tight angle. Tim Iroegbunam equalised in the 58th minute, his right-footed finish from inside the box skidding into the corner after McBurnie's pass. McBurnie, maker of the leveller, then put Hull ahead midway through the second half, his right-footed shot low to the corner giving them two goals in 10 minutes. Julio Enciso replied with 16 minutes left, taking a pass from Azor Matusiwa, on for Florentino, and sending a left-footed shot from long range into the top corner.

sections.head: Iroegbunam levels
sections.pitch: Iroegbunam's leveller was the Tigers' opening goal of the match and wiped out the lead Ipswich had carried into half-time.

sections.head: Florentino strikes
sections.pitch: Florentino gave the Tractor Boys their only goal of the opening half and the advantage they took in at the break.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: McBurnie 9 (its_ohi), Iroegbunam 7, Florentino 7, Enciso 6 (If anyone can, Bannan can)

reports.standfirst: Manchester City stay top despite a 1-0 defeat to Brighton & Hove Albion, Yasin Ayari's goal deciding it.
reports.account: Ayari struck after 11 minutes, meeting Maxim De Cuyper's set-piece pass inside the box and sending a left-footed shot low past the keeper into the corner.

sections.head: Ayari decides it
sections.pitch: Ayari has three league goals this season and his effort at the back brought one mark. Luka Vuskovic lasted all of it with City kept out, taking the full two for his defending.
sections.stake: domeitalycoach has Ayari on the bench, for nine points; The Truffle Pigs has Vuskovic, for eight points against domeitalycoach.

sections.head: Verbruggen saves seven
sections.pitch: Bart Verbruggen saved seven times and conceded nothing, with Lewis Dunk on the pitch for the duration of the win as well.
sections.stake: Cowthenbeef has Verbruggen, for eight points; Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza has Dunk, for six points.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Ayari 9 (domeitalycoach), Verbruggen 8 (Cowthenbeef), Costinha 8, Vuskovic 8 (The Truffle Pigs)

reports.standfirst: Tottenham Hotspur beat Crystal Palace 2-0, Jean-Philippe Mateta's early red card leaving his side a man short.
reports.account: Mateta was sent off after 13 minutes, and Palace's ten fell behind 12 minutes after the red card when Archie Gray headed Mohammed Kudus's corner low inside the post from within the six-yard box. Jan Paul van Hecke added a header from another corner with 17 minutes left, from close range through the centre of the goal.

sections.head: van de Ven
sections.pitch: Van Hecke now has two league goals this season. He took five shots, and the three chances he set up were matched by Micky van de Ven, with both lasting the full distance without Spurs conceding.
sections.stake: domeitalycoach has van Hecke, for 12 points; The Truffle Pigs claimed van de Ven on Wednesday, for six points.

sections.head: Robertson provides openings
sections.pitch: Antonín Kinsky kept Palace off the scoresheet throughout, and Andy Robertson laid on three chances for team-mates in the win.
sections.stake: If anyone can, Bannan can claimed Kinsky on Thursday, for six points; Bayern Bru claimed Robertson on Wednesday, for six points against The Raccoons.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: van Hecke 12 (domeitalycoach), Kinsky 6 (If anyone can, Bannan can), Robertson 6 (Bayern Bru), Kudus 6 (The Truffle Pigs)

keyStats.label: Clean sheet, full match
keyStats.value: Kinsky, van Hecke, van de Ven

reports.standfirst: Aston Villa drew 1-1 with Fulham, Nicolas Jackson's goal cancelled out by a Zion Suzuki own goal.
reports.account: John McGinn missed a penalty after 16 minutes. Jackson put Villa ahead in the 39th minute, taking Johan Manzambi's pass inside the box and placing a right-footed shot low in a corner, a lead Villa carried into half-time. Suzuki turned the ball into his own net midway through the second half to bring Fulham level.

sections.head: Jackson now on five
sections.pitch: Jackson has five league goals this season, and this one came after McGinn's miss had kept the score level for Villa.
sections.stake: The Truffle Pigs has him, for six points.

sections.head: Iwobi goes close
sections.pitch: Alex Iwobi took three shots and had chances good enough to score, with his defending rewarded once in the draw.
sections.stake: GlengarryHearts has him, for six points.

keyStats.label: Points
keyStats.value: Jackson 6 (The Truffle Pigs), Iwobi 6 (GlengarryHearts), Manzambi 5 (Cowthenbeef), Maatsen 3 (AtleticoTimHortons)
